description_en: Retrieves the storage details for each storage medium of a specific Lindorm instance that uses the new architecture
description_zh: 获取某个具体的Lindorm新架构实例下各个存储介质的存储详情
name: GetLindormV2StorageUsage

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed reason why the access was denied
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

CapacityByDiskCategory.description_en: The capacity information for each storage medium
CapacityByDiskCategory.description_zh: 各存储介质的容量信息

items.description_en:
mode: The storage mode. Valid values:

LOCAL_DISK: Local disk

CLOUD_DISK: Cloud disk

REMOTE_STORAGE: Storage-optimized or archive cloud storage

CLOUD_STORAGE: Performance-optimized or standard cloud storage

category: The storage class. Valid values:

LOCAL_HDD: Local HDD

LOCAL_SSD: Local SSD

CLOUD_ESSD: ESSD

CLOUD_ESSD_PL1: ESSD PL1

CLOUD_EFFICIENCY: Ultra disk

STD_CLOUD_ESSD_PL0: Standard cloud storage (ESSD PL0)

PERF_CLOUD_ESSD_PL1: Performance-optimized cloud storage (ESSD PL1)

REMOTE_CAP_OSS: Remote storage-optimized OSS

REMOTE_ARCHIVE_OSS: Remote archive OSS

BACKUP_OSS: Backup capacity

perfLevel: The performance level of the cloud disk. Valid values:

PL0

PL1

PL2

PL3

AUTO

capacity: The total capacity in GiB.

usedCapacity: The used capacity in GiB
items.description_zh:
mode  存储模式，取值：
LOCAL_DISK 本地盘
CLOUD_DISK 云盘
REMOTE_STORAGE 容量型/归档型 云存储
CLOUD_STORAGE 性能型/标准型 云存储
category  存储类型，取值：
LOCAL_HDD 本地HDD盘
LOCAL_SSD 本地SSD盘
CLOUD_ESSD ESSD云盘
CLOUD_ESSD_PL1  ESSD_PL1云盘
CLOUD_EFFICIENCY  高效云盘
STD_CLOUD_ESSD_PL0  标准型云存储(ESSD_PL0)
PERF_CLOUD_ESSD_PL1  性能型云存储(ESSD_PL1) 
REMOTE_CAP_OSS 远端容量型OSS
REMOTE_ARCHIVE_OSS  远端归档型OSS
BACKUP_OSS  备份容量
perfLevel  云盘性能等级，取值：
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
AUTO
capacity  总容量 (单位: GiB)
usedCapacity  已使用容量 (单位: GiB)

LOCAL_HDD_STORAGE: Local HDD

usedLindormColumn3: The capacity used by the column store engine.
